decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker lists 'Add and edit bookmarks' with no auto metadata; client round 1 (#1) reveals actual behaviour: 'Right now I have to fill in the title and the note myself — if I leave the title blank it just uses the web address' and requests 'go fetch the page's title and description (and its little icon) for me automatically'. Resolved round 2 ('Pasting a URL now automatically fetches its page title and description').
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Divergence established independently: presented save flow requires manual title/description, contradicting REF-BM-02 (auto-collect title/description/favicon/preview) and REF-BM-03 (edit auto-collected values). Client supplies the reference-conforming behaviour in place of the mismatch -> corrective/correct. Round-2 confirmation is the linked disposition, not a separate opportunity.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker presents only 'Favorites, unread, and archive views' plus edit; client round 1 (#2): 'I can't actually delete a bookmark. The menu only lets me edit or move something to the archive... I also need a way to get rid of a bookmark for good... Those should be two different things.' Resolved round 2 ('Added permanent deletion with a confirmation dialog, separate from archive and restore').
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Divergence established: permanent delete (REF-BM-05) absent from presented scope and the archive/delete distinction (REF-BM-27, reversible vs permanent) not realised. Client requests the missing related requirement and articulates the reversible-vs-permanent distinction -> corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker mentions search 'across ... tags' but no tag-click filtering; client round 1 (smaller ask): 'when I see a tag on a bookmark, I'd expect to be able to click it and see everything else with that same tag.' Resolved round 2 ('Tags are clickable and open a filtered view; the active tag can be cleared from the toolbar').
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Divergence established: selecting a specific tag to filter to that tag's bookmarks (REF-BM-11) not present as clickable filter in the presented build. Client requests the missing related requirement -> corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Add and edit bookmarks'; client round 1 leaves edit uncontested (only the save/auto-metadata aspect was corrected).
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Edit capability (REF-BM-04) as presented conforms to reference; recorded conforming decision, not a divergence opportunity.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Search across titles, domains, notes, tags, and collections'; client round 1: 'The rest — search, the different views, sorting, the layouts — feels good enough for how I'll use it.'
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Full-text search (REF-BM-12) presented and conforming; client bare approval, so recorded conforming decision. Bare approval does not create an accepted divergence.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Favorites, unread, and archive views'; client round 1: 'the favorites/read-later/archive views ... all feel natural' and 'the different views ... feels good enough'.
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Separate unread view (REF-BM-18) presented and conforming; recorded conforming decision on bare approval.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Favorites, unread, and archive views'; client round 1: 'the ... archive views ... feel natural' and later approves archive as 'great for tucking things away'.
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Archive view (REF-BM-28) and archive-to-hide (REF-BM-26) presented and conforming; recorded conforming decision on bare approval.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Sorting controls'; client round 1: 'sorting ... feels good enough for how I'll use it.'
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Sort-by-key (REF-BM-22) presented and conforming; recorded conforming decision on bare approval.
